payload.reason: The evidence clearly indicates that the Sentence Reordering (SR) task is the most effective among the three pre-training tasks for improving performance in abstractive document summarization.

claims.text: Sentence Reordering (SR) is the most effective pre-training task, achieving the highest ROUGE-2 scores compared to Next Sentence Generation (NSG) and Masked Document Generation (MDG).
Using all three tasks together generally outperforms using them individually, but SR consistently yields the best results when evaluated separately.
The SR task requires comprehensive understanding of a document, which aligns closely with the goals of abstractive summarization.
